scope: ISA transport, encoding, operands and boundaries frozen; numerical interpreter validation and detailed compute implementations remain pending.

instruction_record.word_order: PS writes bits31:0 first, followed by63:32,95:64,127:96; serialized bytes little-endian
instruction_record.reserved_rule: Every bit outside the opcode payload format must be zero; ignored bank fields zero; opcode12 rejected.

command_transport.chunk_state: START resets PC/program bookkeeping only; bank descriptors, generation, data, scales and DDR KV remain; coordinated reset separately invalidates descriptors.

quant_field_rules.A_dynamic: m_start selects BF16 source rows; m_count1..32; k576 or1536; kv_len/query_start/layer zero; output rows renumbered from0.
quant_field_rules.Q_dynamic: m_start0; m_count1..32; k64; kv_len/query_start/layer zero; nine heads.
quant_field_rules.K_V_static: m_start0; m_count1..32; k64; layer0..29; other fields zero; bank1=B7 acquired.
quant_field_rules.P_dynamic: m_start0; m_count1..32; k=kv_len1..1024; query_start+m_count<=kv_len; layer0; nine heads; causal/padding lanes excluded from scale reduction and quantized to0.
quant_field_rules.DEQUANTIZE: mode0; m_start0; m_count1..32; k576; other fields zero.

BANK_CONFIG_rules.profile: one of profile_encodings and allowed by the chosen bank
BANK_CONFIG_rules.dimensions: rows, cols interpreted by profile; profile-specific shape/byte extent checked before mutation
BANK_CONFIG_rules.position: RoPE/attention logical position; unused profiles require0
BANK_CONFIG_rules.layer: cache/static profiles layer0..29; unused profiles require0
BANK_CONFIG_rules.component: B7:0 full initialization,1 RoPE-window update preserving static table,2 static-table update preserving RoPE window; other banks require0
BANK_CONFIG_rules.generation: nonzero32-bit monotonically increasing within bank/component until coordinated reset; no wrap; no command may reconfigure a busy bank
BANK_CONFIG_rules.validity: configuration invalidates only targeted component; never marks data/scale valid without successful covered writes

DMA_rules.address_range: 32-bit address plus byte count must not wrap; DDR map checked by PS/handoff
DMA_rules.aux: normally0; embedding scale-block load sets bit0=1 and bits2:1=selected FP32 lane0..3; all remaining bits0. Only bank3 profile embedding_rows_INT8 sidecar transfers permit this flag.
DMA_rules.embedding_scale: PS derives source block=floor(token_id/64)*16 and lane=floor(token_id/16)%4; transfer16 bytes per row to scale sidecar+row*16; PL reads selected lane.
DMA_rules.scale_padding: prepared source scale tail padded to16 bytes; no read past the declared padded image region

GEMM_rules.shapes: A rows1..32, k576 or1536; m_start+m_count<=A rows; n_tile1..192; Ntotal1..49152; n_start+n_tile<=Ntotal
GEMM_rules.N_alignment: n_start multiple64 for aligned scale DMA; PS residency tile widths64/128/192, final tail permitted
GEMM_rules.destination: configured BF16 profile rows=m_count, cols=Ntotal; each tile writes logical columns n_start..n_start+n_tile; destination ready only after all configured output cells covered
GEMM_rules.scales: A scale floor(source_row/16); B scale floor(tile_local_channel/16); neither varies across K
GEMM_rules.shared_core: GEMM, QK and PV collectively allow one in-flight core command

attention_rules.causal: key_index<=query_start+query_row; padded lanes0; Softmax uses explicit mask, not numeric zero score as validity
attention_rules.cache_layer_match: cache descriptor layer must match its copied static scales; no stale cross-layer scale

weight_pingpong.prefetch: PS places next-bank loads after current GEMM acceptance; no implicit DMA or model scheduling
weight_pingpong.release: matched completion after final BF16 output write; source A remains valid across releases
weight_pingpong.epochs: BANK_CONFIG generations and dispatcher transaction identity are separate; both retained until matched release

executor_policy.request: cmd_valid/cmd_ready, opcode, bank IDs, payload, transaction ID and captured descriptor generations
executor_policy.response: resp_valid/resp_ready, transaction ID, used-bank mask/count/IDs, captured generations, error code; echo accepted identity

cache_reload_sequence: DMA_STORE current K/V payload to position*192 byte offsets
BANK_CONFIG B8/B9 for full cache prefix, layer identity and fresh generation
DMA_LOAD full INT8 K/V payload prefix
DMA_LOAD K16/V48-byte padded scales from prepared static-KV DDR table to their sidecars
ATTN_SCORE_INT8 / ATTN_VALUE_INT8 only after both data and scale coverage valid
cache_reload_note: BANK_CONFIG invalidates cache scales along with data; explicitly reload scales, never assume old sidecar remains valid. B7 resident table is used by static QUANTIZE; DDR copies are transport only.
